code_examples.section: ltm rule event HTTP REQUEST DATA
code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

HTTP_REQUEST_DATA
       Triggered when an HTTP::collect command has collected the specified amount of request data.

DESCRIPTION
       An iRule event triggered when an HTTP::collect command has collected the specified amount of request data. Also triggered
       if the client closes the connection before the HTTP::collect command finishes processing.

Examples
	when HTTP_REQUEST {
	  HTTP::collect 20
	}
	when HTTP_REQUEST_DATA {
	  # do stuff with the payload
	  log local0. "The first 20 bytes of the payload are: [HTTP::payload]"
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-9.0.0 --First introduced the event.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
